title: The Fake Ribbon at the Science Fair
intro: Minutes before judging, the grand prize at the school science fair has been swapped for a convincing fake.

suspects.name: Marcus
suspects.line: I only touched the wires for my robot, I swear.

suspects.name: Omar
suspects.line: Judges love a good trophy photo, so I took a few.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: My volcano is bubbling, so I stayed right by it.

suspects.name: Ruby
suspects.line: Me? I was checking the snack table. Ask anyone.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: I was in the gym, practicing my cheer routine.

clues.text: The baking-soda foam is still bubbling on the volcano table, and the judges agree the culprit was nowhere near it, so they were not last seen there.
The toolbox still sits untouched on its shelf, and the custodian confirms its owner was never near it, so the culprit was not carrying a toolbox.
A smudged sticky-note sign-in sheet shows the culprit's hands were clean that morning, so they were definitely not the sticky-fingers type, who left glue on everything.
A witness saw someone hurrying past with a camera slung over one shoulder, clicking away and clearly carrying a camera, not anything else.
